change: Batch Git object reads for exact staged credential scans; ordinary working-tree behavior and all current credential signatures preserved.
algorithm: Read NUL-framed stage0 paths/OIDs; refuse any conflict stage before scanning. Paths containing newline/tab/Unicode/leading colon are not interpolated into blob requests.
One metadata batch over unique OIDs; require exact OID/blob/type/canonical safe integer size<=64MiB; missing/nonblob errors fail closed.

Read unique OIDs in groups bounded to32MiB INCLUDING Git header/newline framing; a single blob up to existing64MiB limit gets only its exact checked framing allowance. Strict header/body-size/newline/no trailing bytes.
Scan every payload as UTF8, including binary files and staged symlink targets. Reuse each OID finding list but map to every original path/order.
Disable Git replacement refs for exact staged object bytes; API remains synchronous. Sanitize failed Git output so potential secret contents are never exposed.

actual_fixture_cases: deleted working file and staged symlink target
identical OIDs map findings to each path; actual small fixture needs3Git subprocesses
32MiB headers count toward grouping;64MiB positive and64MiB+1 metadata-only refusal
corrupted OID/type/size/terminator/truncation/trailing output and Git failure refuse
failed Git stdout/stderr values withheld from function error and actual CLI output

actual_index_benchmark.scope: Read-only actual index scan, no original slow rerun or production activity.

validation.benchmark_limits: One actual read-only index run; not an old-vs-new same-index ratio. Benchmark was before final catch-only sanitization hunk; normal successful read/scan path unchanged. Reported prior~2min is root observation, not independently measured here.

safety: No skipped binary/evidence files; no credential pattern relaxed.
No root source/index modifications; no network/providers/production facts or release actions.
Index and metadata outputs are each also bounded32MiB; unexpected Git failures refuse.
limits: Actual Node peak RSS675.3MiB; bounded child output is not a guarantee of32MiB total process memory.
Large finding lists can consume memory proportional to requested findings, as before.
Unsupported nonblob gitlinks fail closed; no unsupported tracked entry is silently skipped.
Independent source review and protected integration remain root-owned.
